commit.note: spec step rules + frame + alpha (Ledger.Commit and Store.Apply: rows after = records folded onto rows before) on every committed commit of the traces

replay.note: Ledger.Replay is a stutter of ledger and store; F-1306 (replay re-applies post-commit properties) is outside these traces (live/model evidence in findings/audit/13.json)

enable-genesis.note: genesis over pre-enable rows: rows unchanged and replay(hist) = alpha(rows)

reenable-adoption.note: adoption: rows unchanged, replay(hist) = alpha(rows) after; the race F-1103 is not in the trace

disable-strict.note: SetEnabled only; strict mode is not in the model

erase-graph.note: sequential: Store.EraseRows+EraseIndex; concurrent (corr-trace-f1201): not a step of the reviewed protocol (F-1201)

redact-start.grade: trace-checked (as built; the reviewed atomic Start is not represented)
redact-start.note: the pin has no Start transaction: unlocked opening reads (no journaled write) and the marker written by the first batch; the reviewed design's locked Mark has no counterpart (F-1302, F-1303)

redact-batch.note: every tombstone's digest recomputed = SHA-256(CanonicalRecord) of the record it replaced

redact-stop-resume.grade: trace-checked (pause and resume); process-kill stop not represented here
redact-stop-resume.note: a killed batch is the IRIS contract's Process stop clause (env-contract-r2); the rescanning resume is F-C1303

verify.note: the verdict itself is graph-blind (F-1401); verify racing commits (P-1401) not represented

readers.note: the check-once race F-1402 needs concurrency and is not represented in these traces

post-commit-properties.grade: trace-checked as a premise instance (not a Biz step)
post-commit-properties.note: a Store.Apply outside the ledger: premise P-C02 is violated by design (F-1101)
